messages:
oliver-sales: Heads-up 1 Finova wants a 2-week private/on-prem POC next Wed. They asked for a one-page preflight and quick answers on access (VPC peering vs private endpoint), short-lived API keys for initial smoke, and installer SA token rotation. Who can take point?

mira-platform: I can coordinate infra. We need to know if their cluster is internet-restricted or only allows whitelisted egress. That changes whether we recommend peering or a private endpoint.

oliver-sales: They said no public egress if possible, Azure-hosted VNet owned by their infra team.

ken-eng: If they block egress, Private Endpoint / PrivateLink is safer; peering still touches route tables. We'll want an internal-only control plane. Also need their allowed CIDRs and admin jump host IPs for temporary access.

infra-bot: Note: installer downloads images from our registry by default. If they only allow their corporate registry, we support image mirror config. Provide registry FQDN and certs. :robot_face:

ken-eng: Hardware checks to ask for:
- exact GPU model (A100-80GB vs A100-40GB)
- kernel version (uname -r) + distro
- k8s version and CRI (containerd/dockerd)
- whether they preinstall NVIDIA driver or want us to (our installer can install driver but needs kernel-headers)

mira-platform: Also ask for disk type (nvme vs sata) and PV size class for model shards. If they want local SSDs, we need node-affinity guidance.

oliver-sales: Can we give them a short driver/CUDA validation snippet they can run?

ken-eng: Yep, share this:
```
# on a gpu node
uname -r && lsb_release -a
modinfo nvidia | head -n 3 || echo "nvidia module missing"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,fb_memory_usage --format=csv
# kubernetes side
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl describe node <gpu-node> | egrep -i "nvidia|allocatable" -A 4
```
If nvidia-smi fails, they probably need driver/kernel fix or headers for DKMS.

infra-bot: Reminder: our DKMS path requires matching kernel headers. If they use non-standard kernels you must provide headers or we use a prebuilt kernel-compatible image.

ken-eng: For temporary hosted API keys: we can issue a scoped key (30 days) limited to non-prod models and low qps. It won't access customer-dedicated pools. Ops must create it, file a ticket including org-id.

sara-security: Security checklist items:
- Installer SA: create a service account with minimal RBAC (pods/create, pods/exec limited, configmaps/secrets read if needed). Provide a kubeconfig token with TTL.
- KMS: recommend CMK + envelope encryption. If they refuse, document key-wrapping flow.
- Audit: retention window + log shipping endpoint. We need to know retention requirement to size logs.

mira-platform: Networking specifics we need from them:
- control plane allowed CIDRs
- worker subnet CIDRs and node IP plan
- egress policy / proxy host:port + auth method
- whether they allow outbound to our image registry and package repos (urls)

oliver-sales: Pricing note from Finova: they want a rough OPEX for a 2-week trial: 1x A100 worker + control plane + on-call support. Use POC pricing.

ken-eng: We'll estimate after they confirm expected concurrency / tokens per second. For Dedicated burst plans we also need peak concurrent requests.

mira-platform: Action items:
- mira-platform: send compact preflight checklist and private-endpoint vs peering pros/cons (ETA: today)
- ken-eng: provide driver & cuda validation snippet + fallback notes (ETA: today)
- sara-security: provide minimal SA RBAC template and KMS questions (ETA: tomorrow)
- oliver-sales: collect node/kernel/k8s details and pricing ask, schedule preflight call (ETA: EOD)

infra-bot: If they are behind a proxy, include CA bundle and set imagePullSecrets or mirror registry. Also ensure time sync (chrony/ntp) is configured.

oliver-sales: I'll loop in Finova infra and get the CIDRs + proxy details. Setting up a 30m preflight for Monday. Thanks all.
